description: Erection of a carport containing two vertical raising cranes
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (7091-HAB-XX-XX-DR-A-P001 Rev P02, 7091-HAB-XX-XX-DR-A-P002 Rev P02, 7091-HAB-XX-XX-DR-A-P003 Rev P02, 7091-HAB-XX-XX-DR-A-P004 Rev P02, 7091-HAB-XX-XX-DR-A-P005 Rev P02, Design and Access Statement 7091-HAB-XX-XX-RP-A-0002 Rev P02 dated 08/10/2019, and Cover Letter and Flood Risk Assessments dated 4th October 2019 received: 10/10/2019. Imperial Handmade Bricks Technical Information, and Unnumbered image of brickwork, received: 29/11/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The roof of the proposed structure shall be finished in Alwitra Evalon waterproof membrane in slate grey colour. The flank wall of the proposed structure shall be finished in Weathered Original London Stock Brick.

Condition : 4 - The proposed soundproofing measures (Rockwool Acoustic membrane at roof level, and Maxiboard Masonry Wall) as specified in Design and Access Statement 7091-HAB-XX-XX-RP-A-0002 Rev P02 dated 08/10/2019 shall be implemented as approved.
Condition : 5 - No vehicle servicing or repair work shall take place in external areas of the site.
